The keep-bit is a GF(2)-linear parity of masked seed bits, so 4-way uniformity holds only if the eight mask vectors (after the fold-to-one-bit mapping) are independent as functions over the 1024 seeds. I'll record this as the primary in-scope claim, plus a related structural one about dependence collapsing pattern counts.
